we present a novel approach of a rigorous bundle adjustment, which enables an accurate and efficient maximum-likelihood optimization of the camera orientation parameters with image and scene data at infinity.

the spherical normalization of homogeneous coordinates is a very efficient way to handle points at infinity and to enable the usage of omnidirectional and stereo camera data within the bundle adjustment process.

(1) the spherical normalization is a general and efficient approach for a bundle adjustment of multi-camera systems with points at infinity and (2) the spherical normalization can be used for bundle adjustment with single-view point omnidirectional cameras.
